question: Should `createChannelIngressMonitor` be accepted now as the supported public plugin-SDK contract for durable channel ingress, rather than keeping this phase scoped to owner-local helpers?
rationale: The implementation intentionally promotes a shared lifecycle abstraction through the public SDK, which creates a compatibility commitment beyond the three refactored channel modules.

options.title: Approve the public monitor contract
options.body: Accept the documented monitor API as the canonical reusable ingress seam after the channel/SDK owner confirms its lifecycle and payload boundaries.

options.title: Keep the seam internal for now
options.body: Pause or narrow the refactor if the team wants more pilot experience before publishing this lifecycle contract to external plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve the public monitor contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented monitor API as the canonical reusable ingress seam after the channel/SDK owner confirms its lifecycle and payload boundaries.
